title_bridge: Bridge: your Ownfoil, AeroFoil or Tinfoil library in Lantern · Lantern
description_bridge: The Lantern Bridge: a gateway that presents an Ownfoil or AeroFoil server, a Tinfoil shop or plain folders of games as a Lantern server, what it reads, how it works and how to try it.
bridge_title: The Bridge: your library, spoken in Lantern
bridge_lede: A gateway that presents an Ownfoil or AeroFoil server, a Tinfoil shop or plain folders of games as a Lantern server, so that Lantern clients can browse it, download from it and sync with it.
bridge_status: Under construction, nothing released yet. Today the bridge serves an empty library; the sources, the web interface and the image come next, following the latest draft.
bridge_sources_lede: It runs next to your library and changes nothing in it. Several sources at once, merged by SHA-256.
bridge_src_folders_x: Games laid out in folders, read in place.
bridge_src_tinfoil_x: Any shop that speaks Tinfoil's index.
bridge_src_ownfoil_x: Its GraphQL API and its live changes.
bridge_src_aerofoil_x: Saves, cheats, requests and content rating.
bridge_how_lede: A library the clients already understand, with none of the work on their side.
bridge_how_1_x: Lantern asks for the SHA-256 of every file. With the games mounted read-only, the bridge hashes them on disk and serves them itself; a slower remote mode hashes what it downloads, once.
bridge_how_2_x: Everything the SDK's server toolkit does: pairing with a code or a QR code, device-bound tokens, invitations, a rating cap carried by the token.
bridge_how_3_x: The state of the sources and of the hashing queue, the devices to approve, live logs and the configuration.
bridge_run_lede: Nothing is released yet, so the bridge runs from a checkout (Python 3.12 or later, uv).
bridge_run_1_x: Clone it with its SDK submodule and serve it.
bridge_run_2_x: Any Lantern client, or curl, can already read its handshake.
bridge_run_note: It serves an empty library for now.
bridge_trust_1_x: It changes nothing in your library: the games are mounted read-only.
bridge_trust_2_x: It follows no URL outside the origin it was configured with, and caps what it reads.
bridge_trust_3_x: Checked in CI with the specification's conformance suite, over fake upstreams.
bridge_cta: Follow the work, or build your own server with the SDK.
sim_title: Try the Bridge without installing it
sim_lede: Pick the sources your library lives in. The bridge reads them all and serves one library, merged by SHA-256: that is what a Lantern client would see. The games are made up, and nothing leaves your browser.
sim_json: The /apps answer, as the client reads it
